negative_controls.reason: REFUSE_PAIR_UNIDENTIFIED — name-only, held Act cannot supply the cited sections
REFUSE_YEAR_CONFLICT / PREDECESSOR_CANDIDATE — printed year names an Act we do not hold
REFUSE_YEAR_CONFLICT / DIGIT_EDIT_1 — one digit from a held year; this lane does not rule a court typed it wrong
REFUSE_AMBIGUOUS — several held Acts share the key and no year was printed
REFUSE_UNHELD — no held Act carries the key at all

how_to_attack: For each positive: does the raw_context support the Act the link names, or its predecessor? section_held=false is a hint, not the test — the silent failures pass it.
For each collision key: is the pair linked to the right one of the colliding Acts, or refused?
For each negative control: confirm it is still refused in the live DB. A control that has become a link is the finding.
The positives are 3 per (Act x forum x decade), so a defect confined to one decade of one court is discoverable; a proportional draw would not be.
